text: {"hierarchy":4,"layout_spacing":3,"typography":3,"color_contrast":4,"consistency":3,"overall":3,"reason":"The design has a bold color-blocked layout and eye-catching cat imagery, but the cramped overlap of the sticker grid with the promotional text, the low-contrast 'FREE' headline on pink, cut-off 'PET SHOP' text, and cluttered placement make the message hard to read and the composition feel unbalanced."}
